# Test that -coverprofile lists each block once when 'go clean -testcache'
# expires the cached result and the test runs again.
# The cached cover profile must be merged only when the cached result is used.

[short] skip
[GODEBUG:gocacheverify=1] skip

# We're testing cache behavior, so start with a clean GOCACHE.
env GOCACHE=$WORK/cache

go test -coverprofile=cover1.out ./p
! stdout '\(cached\)'

go test -coverprofile=cover2.out ./p
stdout '\(cached\)'
cmp cover2.out cover1.out

go clean -testcache
go test -coverprofile=cover3.out ./p
! stdout '\(cached\)'
cmp cover3.out cover1.out

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.21
-- p/p.go --
package p

func Abs(x int) int {
	if x < 0 {
		return -x
	}
	return x
}
-- p/p_test.go --
package p

import "testing"

func TestAbs(t *testing.T) {
	if Abs(-1) != 1 {
		t.Fatal("Abs(-1) != 1")
	}
}
